lines.text: Sorry? I did not hear you.
Many learners say: Please? I did not hear you.
Better: Sorry? I did not hear you.
Use sorry when you did not hear.
Sorry is right! Sorry? I did not hear you.

data.wrong: Please? I did not hear you.
data.right: Sorry? I did not hear you.
data.why: Use sorry when you did not hear.

native.tip: Im Deutschen fragen wir „Bitte?“, wenn wir etwas nicht gehört haben. Im Englischen sagen Sie dann „Sorry?“.

en.tip: German says “Bitte?” when you did not hear. English says “Sorry?” in that case.
en.caption: “Bitte?” is “Sorry?” here! Wrong: “Please? I did not hear you.” Right: “Sorry? I did not hear you.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
